description.value: The Gluten Free Epicurean is a boutique, dedicated gluten-free and celiac-safe bakery in East Vancouver, founded in 2009 by owner Delainy after her own diagnosis with gluten intolerance. The bakery produces fresh and frozen bread, cakes, and specialty items including vegan, dairy-free, nut-free, and refined-sugar-free options. A touring cyclist with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity would find this a rare and welcome stop for safe baked goods and snacks.
